headline: Kyrgyzstan plans to change the procedure for issuing export and import permits
summary: A draft regulation on permits and other documents for foreign economic activity has been put up for public discussion in Kyrgyzstan. It would change how export and import permits are issued.
why: Export and import permit rules determine how easily goods cross borders. Changes can affect trade costs and timing for traders and importers.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане хотят изменить порядок выдачи разрешений на экспорт и импорт
